In 2012 I co-founded "Spyros Games", a mobile games development studio where I worked as a gameplay programmer. I love creating and playing games and by that time I was aiming to introduce some mid-core games with different ideas that could be recognized globally.

I'm always passionate about learning new technologies and computer science topics. Besides mobile development, I also enjoy learning front-end development technologies and building UI components.

My biggest goal, for now, is to complete my master's degree in computer science. I was not a computer science graduate, but instead, have a bachelor in electronics and communications engineering. Travel also plays a part and influences my painting such as repeat visits to Italy. Engaging with the visual feast Italy offers both in a historical and contemporary contest also helps me to improve la bella lingua.
